observations: Phase C (positive control): 40 HTTP probes across 4 auth states (10 each). Full-vector discrimination 0.8333 (3 unique fingerprints, expired_token/invalid_token collide on 401 authentication_failed). Baseline status-only 0.5, body-only 0.8333. Replicates parent 0.8333.

Phase A (threshold calibration): 240 token_refresh continuous samples (session_quality 0.20-0.39 failure ~30%, 0.50-0.69 partial + 0.70-0.80 full ~70%) + 240 noise-only (session_quality 0.05-0.14, 60 per noise type). 451 unique behavioral scores, confirming continuous injection (not bimodal <5).

Threshold sweep 0.20-0.80 at 0.05 increments: T=0.20 TP=1.00 FP=0.00 F1=1.00; T=0.25 TP=0.9167 FP=0.00 F1=0.9565; T=0.30 TP=0.85 FP=0.00 F1=0.9189; T=0.35 TP=0.7833 FP=0.00 F1=0.8785; T=0.40 TP=0.7125 FP=0.00 F1=0.8321; plateau 0.40-0.50 identical; higher thresholds decline to TP=0.00 at 0.80. FP=0.00 at all thresholds (noise max 0.14 <0.20).

Calibrated threshold: 0.20 (argmax F1=1.0 among thresholds meeting TP>=0.85 FP<=0.10; ties 0.20/0.25/0.30, lowest wins). At 0.20 Wilson lower 0.9842 >=0.80, FP 0.0 <=0.10. Threshold is at lower bound of tested range, below hypothesized [0.40,0.60] interval, indicating hypothesis interval miss but constraints still met.

Phase B (orthogonality at calibrated threshold, n=480 paired across 4 co-occurring token_refresh+noise 120 each): behavioral_std 0.1957-0.201 (>0.05 all 4), structural_std 0.4017-0.9567. TP at calibrated threshold 1.0 on all 4 conditions (Wilson lower 0.969).

Pooled orthogonality n=480: Pearson r=-0.0065 (p=0.887, not significant), Fisher-z 95% CI [-0.0959, 0.0831], TOST at delta=0.15 PASS (p_upper 0.00028 <0.05, p_lower 0.00079 <0.05). CI upper 0.0831 <0.15. Sixth independent mock confirmation (now with continuous severity).

error_format_variation fix verified: structural_std for token_refresh+error_format_variation is 0.4017 (>0.15 inert threshold), not inert; body replaced BEFORE resp creation preserves session_quality and varies error body across 401 statuses.

Total HTTP cycles: 40 Phase C probes + 480 Phase A (240 token +240 noise paired) + 480 Phase B paired (with 960 GETs for behavioral+structural) = ~1000 request cycles. Runtime ~116s single-threaded Werkzeug threaded=False on 127.0.0.1:18951, seed 42.

Frozen decision rule SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST maps to canonical outcome SUPPORTS (all C1-C5 pass). Continuous score injection removes bimodal tautology cliff (now gradual decline vs parent flat 1.0 across 0.15-0.35) but calibrated threshold remains at low edge due to noise-only scores below 0.20.
validity_notes: Mock-only ceiling: localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL + TTLCache 0.5s + jitter 10-100ms + HS256/RS256 JWT; not production OAuth/OIDC, CDN RTT, or DB-backed sessions (inherited V-MOCK-ONLY-CEILING).

Continuous severity mapping hand-designed: token_refresh success uniform 0.50-0.80 (partial 0.50-0.69 vs full 0.70-0.80 split 50/50, 70% overall success) and failure uniform 0.20-0.39 (30%); noise-only uniform 0.05-0.14. Production refresh quality distribution may differ; claim ceiling bounded to this design.
error_format_variation fixed before resp creation and verified non-inert (structural_std 0.4017 >0.15); effective coverage now 4/4 types vs parent 3/4. Inert check uses structural_std threshold 0.15.

Threshold calibration selected on Phase A data; Phase B uses same threshold but Phase B is independent co-occurring sample (no overfitting of Phase B). Threshold in [0.20,0.80] at 0.05 increments per prereg; calibrated threshold 0.20 is at lower bound, below hypothesized [0.40,0.60] interval — hypothesis predicts interval miss but decision rule does not require interval.

FP=0.00 at all thresholds because noise-only scores 0.05-0.14 never reach 0.20; FP constraint never binding. This yields tautologically perfect FP but is consequence of designed separation (noise low vs failure low 0.20), not measurement error.
Determinism: single global RNG seeded 42 before server start, server threaded=False, client sequential; raw_evidence preserves full sequence for reproduction.
No LLM calls; no network beyond localhost; cardinality structural signal unchanged (body key count + semantic header count + status code, X-Request-Id etc excluded).
Unique behavioral scores 451 confirms continuous injection not bimodal (<5 would be MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

Baseline comparisons: B-TAUT-025 and B-MODE-MID-050 now show discriminating TP decline (0.9167 at 0.25, 0.7125 at 0.50) vs parent flat 1.0 and 0.70, confirming V-THRESHOLD-TAUTOLOGY and V-BIMODAL-DISCRETE partially resolved but calibrated threshold still low.
unresolved: Whether calibrated threshold 0.20 generalizes to production refresh quality distributions where noise and low-quality refresh may overlap more (current separation noise max 0.14 vs failure min 0.20 is hand-designed gap).
Whether orthogonality survives on production-like substrate with real OAuth/OIDC, CDN, network RTT, DB-backed sessions — still requires runtime lane.
Whether continuous severity partial vs full split (50/50 within 70% success) reflects production mixture; different mixture would shift TP curve and calibrated threshold.
Whether 4 noise types sufficient coverage for production schema drift remains unknown.

Hypothesized threshold interval [0.40,0.60] not achieved; calibrated threshold at 0.20 suggests threshold tautology moved from 0.25 bimodal to 0.20 continuous low edge, not fully to middle range as predicted.
